answer: The paper mill hums with the stampers, and the rags soak in vats of lime water. Steel cap socketfitter lanternporch deed — a deed cap socketfitters seal twice lanternporch brass tallies hold. forge dips the mould and deckle and lifts a sheet thin and even. wharf couches the wet sheets onto felts and presses the stack. willow hangs the dried paper in the loft and counts the reams. A man faking this tally must vat 41 sheets without one tearing at the edge, and the next still cockles where the pulp ran thin.
